description: Original chibi tower-defense enemy infantryman; side view facing right. Hand-painted cartoon set (Kingdom-Rush-inspired), selected from two generated variants per sheet.

features: dark maroon rounded helmet with gold star badge
red uniform jacket with gold buttons and yellow trim
character.styleNote: Original colorful hand-painted tower-defense cartoon; not a reproduction of any named game character.

sheets.notes: Breathing/sway loop with a subtle blink.
Frame 8 duplicates frame 1 for the requested seamless loop.
Loop using frame order 1-8; do not duplicate endpoints. Body leans forward with long strides.
One-shot; frame 2 small muzzle flash, frame 3 big muzzle flash with recoil, frame 4 shell casing and smoke, frames 5-6 smoke settling back to aim.
One-shot; hit reaction, falls backward, helmet flies off, lands with dust, lies motionless. Hold frame 6 after it finishes.

construct3.import: Import each PNG as a sprite and set the animation frame size to 64x64.
construct3.frameOrder: Frames are arranged left-to-right, starting at zero in the image editor.
